verdict.rationale: Stripe documents dated, pinnable API versions on a formal cadence: monthly releases with no breaking changes, and breaking changes confined to twice-yearly major releases. An upgrades guide and a dated changelog cover the version-transition procedure, and the policy applies platform-wide, including to Billing endpoints. Missing for 10: an explicit sunset/support timeline for old pinned versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the policy works in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: we release new API versions monthly with no breaking changes. Twice a year, we issue a new major release... that starts with an API version containing breaking changes.
To test a newer version for API calls, set the `Stripe-Version` header
Basic usage-based billing, built on the Billing Meters API, is a lower-level primitive that remains fully supported for existing integrations.
